messages:
daria-partnerships: Heads up from APAC marketplace ops 1: PO uploads to CloudMart failing due to tax-id mismatch on reseller entity. Partner portal rejects POs where seller_tax_id != registered_tax_id.

ana-sales: we just heard from reseller (SundryTech) - they updated their portal profile last week, but our PO template still sends the old tax id.

tom-procurement: can you post sample payload? need to confirm field names.

daria-partnerships: sample: `{"po_id":"CM-2026-881","seller":{"name":"SundryTech","tax_id":"TAX-OLD-123"}}` partner expects `"tax_id":"TAX-NZ-789"`.

rebecca-legal: legal redline note: Marketplace terms require the seller to keep tax and registration info current; we should still avoid blocking revenue for a data sync issue. consider a soft-accept with reconciliation.

ops-bot: automated-reject: po CM-2026-881 rejected by cloudmart-gateway: seller_tax_mismatch (payload tax_id != portal record)

tom-procurement: workaround idea: accept PO into "pending-verify" status and surface to partner ops to validate tax_id before fulfillment. finance will not invoice until verified.

ana-sales: that would buy time. partner wants to push 3 demos this week, can't afford weeks of backlog.

daria-partnerships: risk: malicious actor could slip an invalid tax id to misroute funds. need a signed attestation or portal API match.

rebecca-legal: legal ok with pending-verify if we require partner portal api match within 48h or signed attestation attached to PO. Add audit entry of original payload.

tom-procurement: plan: implement pending-verify status; add rule: if seller_tax_mismatch -> route to partnership ops queue and create verification task. ETA: staging deploy in 8 hours, prod after smoke tests tomorrow morning.

daria-partnerships: i'll notify SundryTech and ask them to confirm portal record and upload attestation. will update thread when portal API returns a match. :thumbsup:
